budget.rationale: The six cost categories add up to an estimated $8,700–$11,950, keeping even the high end under the $12,000 target. June 2027 flights, lodging and rail still need live quotes.

weather.rationale: Official 1991–2020 June normals support mostly comfortable Lisbon and Faro-region days, with manageable midday heat and exposed-coast wind rather than climate that conflicts with the plan.

fireRisk.rationale: Moderate is the safety rating (3/5), corresponding to a 5–10% planning chance of material wildfire disruption during the exact trip window. Portugal is one of Europe's highest absolute fire-danger countries and the official summer campaign begins June 1. Coastal Lagos is less exposed than the wooded interior, but Monchique, Sagres, and east–west road excursions add enough wildland interface that fire belongs in the plan.

swim.rationale: The Algarve schedules two meaningful water/coast days and official destination data lists summer sea water at 20–22°C (68–72°F). It is usable but cool, while a Lagos pool is the warm-water fallback.

variety.rationale: The seven-night plan schedules town/culture, coast/water and nature/garden modes; nature is the lighter thread and the route intentionally avoids a third region.

ease.rationale: Two multi-night bases, one rail move, no rental car and no internal flight make this a straightforward week. The international connection from Pittsburgh and the Lagos–Faro departure transfer keep it from a perfect score.

food.rationale: Pizza, pasta, burgers, bakeries and supermarkets give the family dependable choices in both bases. Exact branches and opening hours need a fresh check before the trip.

risk.rationale: The simple route has no fragile internal flight, but exact June 2027 open-jaw air and CP rail are not confirmed. Protected-ticket and Lisbon-airport-night fallbacks keep that uncertainty manageable.

nights.rationale: Seven hotel nights are intentionally compact. The main comparison rewards longer vacations, so every trip of eight nights or fewer receives 1/5 on this measure.

novelty.rationale: Portugal, Lisbon and the Algarve are all new to the family, earning the strongest score for novelty.

pto.rationale: The observed Juneteenth holiday keeps this seven-night trip to only four vacation days, the best time-off fit among these short options.
